title: Quantitative investigation of the effects of DNA modifications and protein mutations on MeCP2-MBD-DNA interactions.
authors: Wang, Qihang; Luo, Song; Xiong, Danyang; Xu, Xiaole; Zhao, Xiaoyu; Duan, Lili
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算定量研究MeCP2-MBD与不同修饰DNA的互作机制，属于TF-DNA类蛋白-DNA结合体系，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: DNA methylation as an important epigenetic marker, has gained attention for the significance of three oxidative modifications (hydroxymethyl-C (hmC), formyl-C (fC), and carboxyl-C (caC)). Mutations occurring in the methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) of MeCP2 result in Rett. However, uncertainties persist regarding DNA modification and MBD mutation-induced interaction changes. Here, molecular dynamics simulations were used to investigate the underlying mechanisms behind changes due to different modifications of DNA and MBD mutations. Alanine scanning combined with the interaction entropy method was employed to accurately evaluate the binding free energy. The results show that MBD has the strongest binding ability for mCDNA, followed by caC, hmC, and fCDNA, with the weakest binding ability observed for CDNA. Further analysis revealed that mC modification induces DNA bending, causing residues R91 and R162 closer to the DNA. This proximity enhances van der Waals and electrostatic interactions. Conversely, the caC/hmC and fC modifications lead to two loop regions (near K112 and K130) closer to DNA, respectively. Furthermore, DNA modifications promote the formation of stable hydrogen bond networks, however mutations in the MBD significantly reduce the binding free energy. This study provides detailed insight into the effects of DNA modifications and MBD mutations on binding ability. It emphasizes the necessity for research and development of targeted Rett compounds that induce conformational compatibility between MBD and DNA, enhancing the stability and strength of their interactions.
abstract_zh: DNA甲基化作为一种重要的表观遗传标记，因其三种氧化修饰（羟甲基胞嘧啶 (hmC)、甲酰胞嘧啶 (fC) 和羧基胞嘧啶 (caC)）的重要性而受到关注。MeCP2的甲基-CpG结合域 (MBD) 中发生的突变导致Rett综合征。然而，关于DNA修饰和MBD突变引起的相互作用变化仍存在不确定性。本研究采用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来探讨DNA不同修饰和MBD突变导致变化背后的机制。结合丙氨酸扫描与相互作用熵方法，精确评估了结合自由能。结果表明，MBD对mCDNA的结合能力最强，其次是caC、hmC和fCDNA，而对CDNA的结合能力最弱。进一步分析揭示，mC修饰诱导DNA弯曲，使残基R91和R162更接近DNA，这种接近增强了范德华力和静电相互作用。相反，caC/hmC和fC修饰分别导致两个环区域（靠近K112和K130）更接近DNA。此外，DNA修饰促进了稳定氢键网络的形成，但MBD中的突变显著降低了结合自由能。本研究提供了关于DNA修饰和MBD突变对结合能力影响的详细见解，强调了研究和开发靶向Rett化合物、诱导MBD与DNA构象兼容性、增强其相互作用稳定性和强度的必要性。
